text_en: Now the apostles and the believers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also accepted the word of God.
text_cn: 宗徒和在犹太的弟兄听说了，连外邦人也接受了天主的圣道。

text_en: So when Peter went up to Jerusalem, the circumcised believers criticized him,
text_cn: 及至伯多禄上到耶路撒冷，那些受割损的人为难他说：

text_en: saying, “Why did you go to uncircumcised men and eat with them? ”
text_cn: “你竟进了未受割损人的家，且同他们吃了饭！”

text_en: Then Peter began to explain it to them, step by step, saying,
text_cn: 伯多禄便开始按次解释说：

text_en: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision. There was something like a large sheet coming down from heaven, being lowered by its four corners; and it came close to me.
text_cn: “我在约培城祈祷的时候，在神魂超拔中见了一个异像：由天上降下一个器皿，好像一块大布，系着四角，从天缒下，一直来到我面前。

text_en: As I looked at it closely I saw four-footed animals, beasts of prey, reptiles, and birds of the air.
text_cn: 我往里面定睛细看，见有地上的四足兽、野兽、爬虫和天空的飞鸟。

text_en: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Get up, Peter; kill and eat. ’
text_cn: 我也听到有声音向我说：伯多禄！起来，宰了，吃罢！

text_en: But I replied, ‘By no means, Lord; for nothing profane or unclean has ever entered my mouth. ’
text_cn: 我却答说：主，绝对不可！因为污秽和不洁之物总没有进过我的口。

text_en: But a second time the voice answered from heaven, ‘What God has made clean, you must not call profane. ’
text_cn: 第二次有声音从天上答道：天主称为洁净的，你不可称为污秽！

text_en: This happened three times; then everything was pulled up again to heaven.
text_cn: 这事竟一连发生了三次。以后，那一切又撤回天上去了。

text_en: At that very moment three men, sent to me from Caesarea, arrived at the house where we were.
text_cn: 正在那时，忽有三个人，来到我们所住的家门前，他们是从凯撒勒雅被派来见我的。

text_en: The Spirit told me to go with them and not to make a distinction between them and us. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered the man’s house.
text_cn: 圣神吩咐我应与他们同去，不必疑惑。同我一起去的，还有这六个弟兄，我们就进了那人的家。

text_en: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying, ‘Send to Joppa and bring Simon, who is called Peter;
text_cn: 那人告诉了我们：他怎样看见天使站在他的屋内，说：你要打发人到约培去，邀请号称伯多禄的西满来。

text_en: he will give you a message by which you and your entire household will be saved. ’
text_cn: 他有话对你讲，使你和你全家得救。

text_en: And as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell upon them just as it had upon us at the beginning.
text_cn: 以后，在我开始讲话时，圣神就降在他们身上，有如当初降在我们身上一样。

text_en: And I remembered the word of the Lord, how he had said, ‘John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit. ’
text_cn: 我就想起了主所说的话：若翰固然用水施了洗，但你们却要因圣神受洗。

text_en: If then God gave them the same gift that he gave us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I that I could hinder God? ”
text_cn: 所以，如果天主赐给了他们同样的恩惠，如同给我们信主耶稣基督的人一样，我是什么人，能阻止天主呢？”

text_en: When they heard this, they were silenced. And they praised God, saying, “Then God has given even to the Gentiles the repentance that leads to life. ”
text_cn: 众人听了这话，才平静下来，并光荣天主说：“原来天主也恩赐外邦人悔改，为得生命。”

text_en: Now those who were scattered because of the persecution that took place over Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, and they spoke the word to no one except Jews.
text_cn: 在斯德望受害时，那些由于窘难而四散的人，经过各地，来到了腓尼基、塞浦路斯和安提约基雅，他们只向犹太人讲道。

text_en: But among them were some men of Cyprus and Cyrene who, on coming to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists also, proclaiming the Lord Jesus.
text_cn: 但其中有些塞浦路斯和基勒乃人到了安提约基雅，也向希腊人讲道，宣传主耶稣的福音。

text_en: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number became believers and turned to the Lord.
text_cn: 主的手同他们在一起，信而归主的人，数目很多。

text_en: News of this came to the ears of the church in Jerusalem, and they sent Barnabas to Antioch.
text_cn: 这事传到了耶路撒冷教会的耳中，就打发巴尔纳伯到安提约基雅去。

text_en: When he came and saw the grace of God, he rejoiced, and he exhorted them all to remain faithful to the Lord with steadfast devotion;
text_cn: 他一来到，看见天主所赐的恩惠就很喜欢，并劝勉众人要决心坚定于主。

text_en: for he was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith. And a great many people were brought to the Lord.
text_cn: 因为他是好人，充满圣神和信德，如此有许多人归附了主。

text_en: Then Barnabas went to Tarsus to look for Saul,
text_cn: 以后，他往塔尔索去找扫禄；

text_en: and when he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. So it was that for an entire year they met with the church and taught a great many people, and it was in Antioch that the disciples were first called “Christians. ”
text_cn: 找着以后，便领他回到安提约基雅。他们一整年在那教会中共同工作，教导了许多人；在安提约基雅最先称门徒为“基督徒”。

text_en: At that time prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.
text_cn: 在那时候，有些先知从耶路撒冷下到安提约基雅。

text_en: One of them named Agabus stood up and predicted by the Spirit that there would be a severe famine over all the world; and this took place during the reign of Claudius.
text_cn: 其中一个名叫阿加波的，因神示起来预言在普世上将有大饥荒，这饥荒就在喀劳狄时发生了。

text_en: The disciples determined that according to their ability, each would send relief to the believers living in Judea;
text_cn: 门徒遂决定，每人按力捐献，把救济物资送给住在犹太的弟兄。

text_en: this they did, sending it to the elders by Barnabas and Saul.
text_cn: 他们都照办了，由巴尔纳伯和扫禄经手，送到长老那里。
